context_packet_summary: Bounded summaries for validation/readiness, assignment queue, Alfred surface, Engineering/CueMastery handoff, pending work packages, and recent active history.

example_mode_prompt_and_response.prompt: Alfred, are you running from JSON files or an LLM right now?
example_mode_prompt_and_response.response: Pat, this answer is being generated through local_llm with provider ollama and model qwen3:8b; JSON artifacts provide context, not the whole response.

example_role_prompt_and_response.prompt: Good afternoon Alfred, define your role for me.
example_role_prompt_and_response.response: Pat, my role is Alfred of the Office of Operations: I coordinate local Estate status, recommendations, and proposed next actions without executing privileged work.

fallback_behavior: Fallback is deterministic and used only when discovery, model selection, or local generation fails; fallback metadata records reason.
known_limitations: Codex container cannot reach Ollama; Steward local Windows smoke check required for real model response.
local_model_discovery_mechanism: LocalOllamaAdapter probes http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags, then falls back to ollama list; no cloud API path exists.
prompt_construction_summary: Prompt identifies Alfred, Pat the Steward, role/office, resident API/version/capabilities, authority status, local-first non-execution policy, bounded Estate context, recent safe history, and current Steward message.
recommended_next_action: Run resident-chat smoke checks on the Steward machine with Ollama running.
selected_alfred_model_policy: Prefer qwen3:8b for Alfred when discovered; otherwise use the first available local model.

ui_mode_transparency_changes: API turn metadata includes llm mode/provider/model/endpoint/fallback fields; Operations Center history and live response render mode/provider/model/reason.
